description: List Hermes sessions from the session registry, newest first. Each row carries its label (title), source, model, last activity, message count, pin/archive state and a short preview, plus a link that renders as a titled link when you refer to the session. Use to find a session to resume, organise, or read — pass archived='archived' for the archived view, archived='all' to include archived rows, pinned_only=true for pins only, search to match a session id or title.
name: sessions_list

archived.description: 'active' (default) hides archived rows, 'archived' lists only them, 'all' includes both.

include_children.description: Include compression/branch children as their own rows. Default false.

limit.description: Max sessions to return. Default 20, max 100.

offset.description: Rows to skip for the next page. Default 0.

pinned_only.description: Only sessions pinned with sessions(pinned=true). Default false.

profile.description: Read another Hermes profile's sessions (read-only). Omit for the current profile.

search.description: Match against a session id or title.

source.description: Only sessions from this source (e.g. cli, telegram).
